description: Rb₂NaInCl₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Rb is bonded to twelve equivalent Cl atoms to form RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent InCl₆ octahedra. All Rb-Cl bond lengths are 3.75 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.76 Å. In is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form InCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All In-Cl bond lengths are 2.54 Å. Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Rb, one Na, and one In atom.
